export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/yash-tooling-system) shows outbound records with the company as shipper: "2026-01-20 | YASH TOOLING SYSTEM | HAMMER NAILS DEUREN BOUWMATERIAL WOOD WORKING TOOLS YASH Glue Joint Cutter Dia 125mm x 30-40 x 40 Bore x 4 Z | AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4, India -> PARAMARIBO, SURINAME | HS 82082000 | BOL 8909396" and "2026-01-15 | YASH TOOLING SYSTEM | ARGAMAN SHARPENING LTD . | WOOD WORKING TOOLS ROUTER BIT AS PER SAMPLE DIA 140 X 10 / 5R X 30 B X 6Z | AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4, India -> TEL AVIV YAFO, Israel | HS 82082000 | BOL 8769509". Page counter: "Total Shipments 1769 Records detected", "Trading Partners 9", "Ports 13", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-13". Rows actually seen in the free view: 5 shipment rows (2 export rows as shipper, 3 import rows as consignee) plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows. Buyer-side counterparties listed include PAXI-FZCO (UAE), INTERIOR TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED (Uganda), INNOVIX WORKSHOP TOOLS L.L.C (Ajman, UAE), WOODWAYS (K) LTD (Nairobi, Kenya), and a Honduras address.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in the sources reachable in this session. The only address evidence is the registered/operating address on the customs record: "PLOT NO. 462, ROAD NO. 12 , GIDC, KATHWADA" (Gujarat). Domestic supply activity is therefore not confirmed and not refuted — null.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: air consignments from Ahmedabad Air Cargo ACC to Suriname (BOL 8909396, 2026-01-20) and Israel (BOL 8769509, 2026-01-15), both under HS 82082000 (wood-working knives/cutting blades) — which matches the declared HS 820220 only partially (8202 chapter, different subheading; 820220 is bandsaw blades, 820820 is wood-working machine knives). The company is simultaneously a significant importer (carbide strips from CY Carbide, PCD saw blades and router bits from Chengdu KWS, Zhejiang Langchao), i.e. it imports semi-finished tooling and re-exports finished wood-working tools — role is best described as manufacturer_trader, not a pure manufacturer. Export volume in USD/tonnes is not public in the free view: null. Domestic (India) supply evidence: no traces found in accessible sources — GST turnover, GeM/CPPP participation and contract awards are all null, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed. Caveat on sourcing: DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) throughout this session and volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403, so the ImportKey free view is the single source used; the 1769-shipment counter could not be independently cross-checked and the free view exposes only 5 of those rows.
